name: VESPER AESTHETICS Iris Couture Prismatic Eye
product_name: Vesper Aesthetics Iris Couture Prismatic Ocular Series
description:
The Iris Couture is a cosmetic ocular replacement built around a 64-zone programmable chromatic iris array, capable of cycling through 16.7 million color configurations and 400 pre-loaded pattern libraries — including bioluminescent sclera wash, holographic pupil overlays, and animated iris motifs synchronized to the wearer's heartbeat or music feed. Functional vision is preserved at baseline human-equivalent resolution with minor low-light enhancement as a secondary feature. The companion Vesper app allows real-time pattern editing via subvocal command or linked wrist node.

The Iris Couture is the accessory of GLMZ's Spire social circuit, worn by performers, influencers, and anyone with a platform to maintain. Vesper releases seasonal pattern collections the way fashion houses release clothing lines, and limited-edition drops sell out within hours. At Tier 2-3 aspirational levels, bootleg pattern packs for older Vesper models circulate on the Shelf as a cheap approximation of Spire glamour.
installation_requirements: Standard ocular socket surgery; Vesper-certified installation recommended for warranty coverage
rejection_risk: Low — biocompatible polymer housing, minimal neural integration depth; rejection rates under 4%
maintenance: Monthly app sync for pattern library updates; annual lens polish at Vesper salon; sclera emitter cleaning every 3 months
